linkedin.text:
🚨 Your ad operations are scattered across twelve platforms, five logins, and three agency dashboards.

You're juggling Google Ads, Meta, Amazon, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, Snapchat, X, Apple, and Pinterest. Every audit is manual. Every optimization lives in a different interface. Every report is a custom export.

Claude Ads just changed that.

✅ Audits campaigns across all twelve platforms with dated evidence and explicit confidence scores
✅ Drafts safe optimizations without touching live budgets until you approve rollback rules and verification windows
✅ Monitors pacing, delivery, tracking, fatigue, policy violations, and performance in one unified workflow

It's read-only by default. Every mutation requires explicit account IDs, before-and-after diffs, blast radius calculation, owner approval, idempotency keys, and verification that remote state still matches your precondition.

The repo already has platform-specific skills for Google, Meta, Amazon, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, Snapchat, X, Apple, and Pinterest. MIT licensed. No membership required.

⭐ Over 200 stars and growing fast.

🔍 Search "AgriciDaniel claude-ads" on GitHub to see the full capability manifest, scoring system, and safety controls.

Are you still managing paid media across twelve separate dashboards?
